g.text: that shitbird wanted a concert? well he got one all right. now, my stage character's always been a bit... much

g.text: always been me with the volume cranked up as high as it could go

g.title: j542423184
g.text: but now? *now?* it was like i was running higher than the clouds, running on some kinda juice i didn't even know *existed*

g.title: j2258543068
g.text: Then what?

g.title: j223725487
g.text: Void's a helluva drug.

g.title: j946049172
g.text: standing on that stage, the new me, i felt... alive. truly alive. more me than i'd ever felt before. it was glorious. freeing. i felt like i was flying

g.title: j2051920628
